g.aria-label: Pipeline Parallel Schedules across p Stages & m Microbatches
GPipe Schedule (All Fwd, Then All Bwd)
Shrinking bubble needs m ≫ p (e.g. m = 32)
Stage 1 holds ALL m activations at once!
Frees microbatch j activation right after B_j!
Caps live activations at ≤ p microbatches!
Interleaved v chunks cuts bubble to (p−1)/(mv)
At Fixed Global Batch B_global = 1,024: m = 1,024 / (d · b) shrinks as DP degree d grows!
At p = 8, b = 1: d = 8 gives m = 128 (5.5% bubble), whereas d = 64 gives m = 16 (43.8% bubble!).
